  · section-gap (hatched spacer band)
  h2 "Use Cases"
  p "Deploy"
  h3 "Host static sites from buckets"
  p "Host JAMstack sites, SPAs, and static assets in a bucket and serve through Applications with high availability. Configure bucket as origin and deliver via Cache for performance."
  link "View example" → https://www.azion.com/en/solutions/jamstack-websites/
  p "Media"
  h3 "Deliver media from centralized storage"
  p "Centralize images, videos, and downloadable assets in Object Storage. Integrate with Cache and Applications for fast delivery. Process media through Functions for optimization."
  link "View example" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/store/storage/use-bucket-as-origin/
  p "Storage"
  h3 "Store application data at scale"
  p "Store user uploads, datasets, logs, and unstructured data in buckets using the S3-compatible API. Scale storage on demand while keeping object access fast."
  link "View example" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/guides/upload-and-download-objects-from-bucket/
  p "Backup"
  h3 "Automate backup and recovery"
  p "Organize backups per bucket and automate upload and restore routines via API. Use multipart upload for reliable large-file transfers. Maintain recovery workflows."
  link "View example" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/guides/create-and-modify-bucket/
  p "AI"
  h3 "Serve AI datasets and models"
  p "Store training datasets, model weights, and inference artifacts. Access from Functions for AI workloads. Integrate with AI Inference for model serving."
  link "View example" → https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/store/object-storage/
  p "Architecture"
  h3 "Build multi-cloud storage"
  p "Use S3-compatible storage as part of a multi-cloud strategy. Standard API enables portability between providers. Avoid ecosystem lock-in with open protocols."
  link "Learn more" → https://www.azion.com/en/products/object-storage/
